record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Topological Algebra
record.context_brief: Measures on compact left topological groups
record.original_question: Does every compact left topological group G support a strictly positive probability Borel measure, meaning a Borel probability measure μ such that μ(U) > 0 for every nonempty open subset U of G?

evidence.quote: compact topological groups support a strictly positive probability measure (i.e., a Borel probability measure µ such that µ(U) > 0 for any nonempty open subset U of the group).
Problem 8 (Protasov). Does every compact left topological group G support a strictly positive probability Borel measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A compact left topological group is a triple (G, ·, τ) where (G, ·) is a group, τ is a compact Hausdorff topology on G, and for every fixed a ∈ G the left translation map x ↦ a·x is continuous from G to G (no continuity is assumed for right translations or for the inversion map). A strictly positive probability Borel measure on G is a Borel probability measure μ on (G, τ) such that μ(U) > 0 for every nonempty open subset U ⊆ G.

Question: Does every compact left topological group G admit a strictly positive probability Borel measure?
artifact.category_tag: Compact left topological groups and Borel measures
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a definitive resolution of Protasov's question on whether every compact left topological group supports a strictly positive Borel probability measure. While classical results give such measures (Haar measure) on compact topological groups, no source confirms or refutes the analogous statement for the merely left-topological setting.

status_evidence.title: Topological Groups: Advances, Surveys, and Open Questions (S. A. Morris ed.)
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of surveys and open problems in topological groups.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit resolution of Protasov's problem on strictly positive measures for compact left topological groups is recorded among the surveyed open problems.

status_evidence.title: Haar measure - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: On a compact topological group, the Haar probability measure is strictly positive.
status_evidence.claim: The strictly-positive-measure property is classical for compact topological groups, but the cited results require joint continuity, not merely left continuity.
